info.title: Pharos API
info.description: Public API of a Pharos server for CI and scripts. Authenticate with a project token or a personal access token: `Authorization: Bearer phr_…`. A token acts as its owner and never does more than the owner's current role allows. Retry only network errors, 429, 502, 503 and 504; an upload is idempotent (the same file in the same run answers 200 and writes nothing).

post.description:
Scope `runs:write`. The body is the report file itself, one file per request (several files: several requests to the same run).

Formats: Pharos Run JSON 1.x, JUnit XML, CTRF, Playwright JSON, Cucumber Messages (NDJSON), SARIF, axe-core JSON and k6 summary; `allure` and `trx` answer 422 `unsupported_format` until their parsers ship.

`Content-Encoding: gzip` is accepted. The body is limited compressed (413) and once decompressed (413); a DTD in XML is refused (422 `invalid_report`, reason `doctype`); reading has a time limit (422 `report_timeout`). Errors never quote the file.

The run: `runKey`, or `externalId` (created by the first upload, open until closed), or a new run closed as completed once imported. Case links are derived when read, from `@<prefix><n>` tags or `caseKey`.

SARIF, axe and k6 bring findings and metrics instead of results: they are stored with the shard as the desktop stores them (ADR-0053) and counted in `counts.findings` and `counts.metrics`. A finding without its rule, severity, message or fingerprint, or a metric without a name or a finite value, is 422 `invalid_report` and nothing is written.

parameters.description: The run of this id in the project, created by the first upload: the jobs of a CI matrix converge on one run (e.g. github:owner/repo:run_id:attempt).

parameters.name: caseKey
parameters.description: Link every result of the file without a case of its own to this case (PH-001).

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Name the raw report is kept under.

get.description:
Scope `cases:read`. Read-only in v1.

Incremental: keep `nextCursor` and send it back as `updatedSince` to get only what changed since (more pages while `hasMore`). Deletions come as `deleted: true` without `data`, unless `includeDeleted=false`.

`status` filters on the item's `status` field.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project's id, or its case-ID prefix (`PHR`) when it is unique within the token's reach (409 `ambiguous_project` otherwise).

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of an earlier page or sync. Omitted: from the beginning.

parameters.name: includeDeleted
parameters.description: Deleted items come as `deleted: true` without `data`, so a mirror can delete them too.

token.bearerFormat: phr_prj_… (project token) or phr_pat_… (personal access token)
token.description: Scopes: projects:read, runs:read, runs:write, cases:read, cycles:read, defects:read, requirements:read.

testCaseId.description: The case it links to, derived when read.

data.description: The document as the server stores it (null when deleted). Unknown fields must be ignored.

nextCursor.description: Send it back as `updatedSince` for the next page, or later for what changed since. Opaque: compare nothing with it.

ItemList.description: In order of change, oldest first. Deletions older than the server's tombstone window (SYNC_TOMBSTONE_DAYS) are no longer listed: a mirror syncs at least that often, like a desktop.

Case.description: A case may carry `sharedRefs[]` and `datasetRefs[]` (ADR-0055 §1-§3): references to the project's shared steps and datasets with `version`, `revisionId`, `follow`, `stepIds` and `args`. They are metadata a client may ignore: the case's `steps` and dataset rows are already a materialized copy, ordinary steps and rows, readable without knowing the library. `<name>` placeholders in steps are the case's parameters.

CaseList.description: A case may carry `sharedRefs[]` and `datasetRefs[]` (ADR-0055 §1-§3): references to the project's shared steps and datasets with `version`, `revisionId`, `follow`, `stepIds` and `args`. They are metadata a client may ignore: the case's `steps` and dataset rows are already a materialized copy, ordinary steps and rows, readable without knowing the library. `<name>` placeholders in steps are the case's parameters.

data.description: The document as the server stores it (null when deleted). Unknown fields must be ignored.

progress.description: The cycle's progress over its items and configurations, as the web shows it (null when deleted).

Error.description: Every error: a stable `code` and a readable `message`, plus fields of that error.
